description: This file defines the PHP class 'OAuthRefreshToken' within the 'OrangeHRM' project, representing the entity for OAuth2 refresh tokens managed via Doctrine ORM. It includes properties for token data, expiry, and revocation status, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshToken
classes.description: Entity class representing OAuth2 refresh tokens, including properties for token identifiers, expiry, status, and related methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the refresh token.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the refresh token.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Sets the access token associated with this refresh token.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time of the token in UTC timezone.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time of the token.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Checks if the token has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Marks the token as revoked or active.
